Home insurance: renewal notice
Policy HM-48213-QC
Dear policyholder,
Renewal date: December 1, 2026
Your home insurance policy renews on December 1, 2026 for one year.
Your new annual premium is $1,284, up from $1,176 last year (+9.2%).
What changed this year:
- Water damage cover now includes sewer backup up to $25,000.
- The deductible for water damage rises from $l,ooo to $1,500.
A 10% discount applies if a water leak detector is installed.
To keep the discount, send a photo of the installed detector
before November 20, 2026.
